channel.title: Stopline News
channel.description: Prop firm and risk news, and the weekly economic calendar, from Stopline.

item.title: Trade Tuesday, Nov 17–24, 2026: The VIX Touched 40, Then Stocks Won Back Half the Drop
item.description: Tuesday to Tuesday: ES fell 5.8% and NQ 7.2% into Friday's close, Bitcoin hit about $55,100 on Saturday, and the VIX touched 40 before Monday's Nvidia-led rally won back about half. Levels, the holiday-week calendar, and why the same $500 risk now buys 3 micro contracts, not 4.

item.title: Take Profit Trader's New Plans: 25K Drawdown Cut to $1,000, and a Daily Loss Limit on the EOD Plan
item.description: Accounts bought from Nov 23, 2026 choose Intraday, Classic or EOD. The 25K max drawdown falls from $1,500 to $1,000, 150K accounts drop from 15 to 12 contracts, 75K and 100K are gone for new buyers, and the EOD plan adds a daily loss limit. Older accounts keep their rules.

item.title: Topstep Makes Challenges Permanent: Hit the Target Twice for a Fixed Payout. The Math Behind It
item.description: Topstep has made its Challenges permanent: one fee of $49 to $599, hit the same target twice against a static Maximum Loss Limit, then take a fixed payout and the account closes. Our math: a trader with no edge passes both rounds about 6% of the time, which is just under break-even on the fee.

item.title: Topstep Stops New Accounts in 13 Countries: What Happens to Combines and Funded Accounts
item.description: Effective Nov 17, 2026, Topstep no longer sells new accounts to traders living in 13 countries. Funded accounts keep trading and paying out; Trading Combines can run only to their paid-through date or Dec 31, 2026.

item.title: FTMO Futures Cuts Growth 100K and 150K Drawdown for New Evaluations
item.description: New FTMO Futures Growth 100K and 150K evaluations created from Nov 5, 2026 have a smaller EOD trailing drawdown ($3,000 and $4,500) and higher qualifying-day minimums ($300 and $450). Older evaluations keep the old values.

item.title: Blue Guardian Futures Zero: Daily Payouts, and an $8,000 Daily Profit Limit You Should Know About
item.description: Blue Guardian's new one-phase Futures Zero plan pays daily with no cap and has no funded consistency rule, but a funded account that makes $8,000 in one day is closed, and news trading is not allowed once funded.

item.title: Economic Calendar: Nov 25 to Dec 1, 2026 (ES, NQ and BTC)
item.description: The US economic releases that can move ES, NQ and Bitcoin from Wednesday, Nov 25 to Tuesday, Dec 1, 2026, with sources, Thanksgiving hours and position sizing guidance.
